text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm opening a small docs PR to add a v1->v2 compatibility shim example for the JS and Python SDKs. Goal: show a minimal wrapper so apps can switch without rewriting call sites.

maria: Nice. can we also include a short note about model swaps (legacy -> recommended v2) + link to the benchmark page? product wants a mapping table.

alex: Yep. plan is: 1) tiny shim snippet, 2) mapping table for common model families, 3) migration checklist (env var, SDK pin, test prompts). Keeping each snippet <= 8 lines.

jen: Quick reminder — update the v1 deprecation banner on the old reference page so it points to the new migration doc. Don't remove v1 snippets yet.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/904 — alex added initial shim example and model table draft.

sam: Reviewed. Two small nits: 1) in the JS example use `client.generate()` (v2 idiom) rather than `client.create()`; 2) add a note about token accounting — v2 counts trailing eos differently which affects small prompts.

alex: Good catches. I'll swap to `generate`, and add a one-line callout about token counting. Also going to add a short console snippet for the hosted API.

kevin: For the model swap table can we surface typical latency/cost delta (rough ballpark) per 1k tokens? Product approved showing ranges if we add a caveat about workload variance.

maria: Product approved the mapping and the ranges. Please link to the microbenchmarks page and add the wording: "typical numbers; results vary by sequence length and batch size."

jen: FYI there's a broken link in /sdk/python/ that points to the old models endpoint. I'll include that fix in a separate tiny PR and mention it in the changelog.

alex: Plan to merge today after CI and docs smoke tests. Who will write the short release-note blurb for the release? Need one line about deprecation window + migration link. Also need an internal note for Dedicated+Private customers about behavior changes.

sam: I'll draft the release note. Pinged Support to update the recommended-models doc and customer-facing migration checklist.

maria: UX ask — include an inline example showing how to opt into quantized model variants in Dedicated config (people ask in onboarding). Keep it as an example snippet only.

alex: Adding quantized opt-in snippet. Final pre-merge checklist I'm running through: run prettier, run smoke tests, update v1 deprecation banner, and add the benchmark link.

jen: +1. set merge strategy to squash and include the PR number in the changelog entry.

alex: Merged (squash). CI green, smoke tests passed. Closing thread.

docs-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-904--docs.redwood.ai — please sanity-check the migration page and the snippets in the playground.

alex: FYI I added a tiny codepen-style playground link for the JS snippet — please click through and verify tokens/cost calculation note renders clearly.

kevin: Tested the preview, LGTM. Thanks all. :ship:
